description: This file defines the 'Parser' class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for parsing tokens into template nodes, handling scope, blocks, macros, and inheritance within Twig templates.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: Parses token streams into Twig template nodes, manages scope, blocks, macros, inheritance, and template embedding.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse a token stream into a ModuleNode representing the Twig template.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Returns the Environment instance associated with this parser.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent node for template inheritance.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns the current token stream being parsed.

methods.name: getCurrentToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current token from the token stream.

methods.name: getExpressionParser
methods.description: Returns the expression parser used to parse expressions within the template.
